providers.licence: CC BY 4.0; Forum Virium Helsinki / HRI attribution. No authentication. No numerical quota documented on the inspected dataset page; one shared export every 30 min (48/day), with timeout, no immediate retries.
providers.cadence: Publisher: sensor reports every 30 minutes, exports refreshed 5–60 minutes. Application stale threshold 3 hours; timestamp is measurement, not download.
providers.scope: Measured lake water temperature at fixed steps sensor, 42m from catalogue point. No neighbouring river/coastal or other-lake substitution. No quality/algae inference.
providers.activation: Existing source-checks collector; no new cron or environment secret.

providers.scope: Official application bundle identifies services731/730 and include observations. Seven matched sites have temperature values; six use old categorical ranges (15–17 etc), not precise measurements; Störsvik has no observation. Vetokannas also has fresh UiRaS numeric measurement. No bacterial sample feed.
providers.remaining: Data reuse/rate contract for the service-map observations not established. Do not treat null expiration_time as evergreen. Direct UiRaS export used for the verified sensor.

providers.scope: All15 screened against responsible municipality/health authority pages. Sample tables and seasonal PDF links found. Most latest dates August2026; Vetokannas September2 (after August25 poor sample); Störsvik latest linked2026 sample June3. Exact sampling-coordinate crosswalk and machine parser/reuse pending.
providers.semantics: Espoo tables distinguish E.coli mpn/100ml and enterococci pmy/100ml; algae0–3, blank cells and <1 must survive normalization. Algae-only Laaksolahti rows must not become new bacterial samples. Do not confuse similarly named Myllylampi in Jyväskylä/Miehikkälä with Vihti.

providers.scope: Existing shared official CAP research reused; no premature repeat of provider probe before October27. Uusimaa geometry/event/expiry/cancellation mapping not validated. Baltic waves/currents do not apply to these lakes.

cameras.fieldOfViewEvidence: Municipality identifies Aurlahden shore; exact mounting coordinates/current field of view unverified. Different Pähkinäniemi marina feed on same channel not substituted.
cameras.freshness: YouTube channel lists stream; player reports Unable to play media in browser on Oct9. No current frame/capture timestamp verified.
cameras.embedding: Not enabled; retain official source page as candidate.

cameraSearchScope: Municipal/tourism/operator searches for Espoo/Oittaa, Kirkkonummi lakes, Lohja lake shores, Siuntio, Vantaa/Vetokannas and Sipoo. Only Aurlahden credible source-page candidate.
